'''Vann''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] that the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] captured on [[Makeb]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]], Vann was part of the team working on stabilizing the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] core along with captured engineers.<ref name="TOR" />
